title: Better mushroom stew craft
description: Adds the ability to craft mushroom stew from any kind of mushroom
body:
**Better Mushroom Stew Craft** is a small but impactful quality-of-life mod that removes the frustration of restrictive crafting recipes. In vanilla Minecraft, you are forced to hunt for both a red and a brown mushroom to create Mushroom Stew. This mod changes that, allowing you to craft the stew using any combination of two mushrooms.

**Why use this mod?**
Stumbling upon a large patch of only red mushrooms (or only brown ones) should not stop you from making food. This mod improves your survival experience, making food production more flexible and consistent without changing the core balance of the game.

**Features:**
- Flexible Recipes: Craft Mushroom Stew using any combination of two mushrooms.

- Vanilla-Friendly: Keeps the original Bowl + 2 Mushrooms balance, just making the ingredients universal.

- Inventory Efficiency: No longer need to waste inventory space holding onto two different types of mushrooms just to craft a meal.

- Lightweight: A mod with zero performance impact.

**Compatibility:**
- Mod Loaders: Compatible with Forge, NeoForge.

- Stackability: Works perfectly with other food-related mods and modpacks.

- Compatibility: No core game files are overwritten, ensuring maximum compatibility with other mods.
